card.name: Bella
traits: large red and pink bow between the ears
holding an orange carrot with a green top
bright magenta outline around a white body
happy curved black eyes and brown whiskers
card.one_line: Bella is a cheerful white bunny with a bright pink bow who loves to nibble on fresh carrots.

pages.scenario: Bella wears a large pink bow. She finds sweet carrots.
pages.question: What should Bella do with her yummy basket?

choices.text: Hide the basket behind a big bush.
choices.feedback: Sharing will bring Bella and her friends more joy.

choices.text: Bring carrots to friends in the meadow.
choices.feedback: Bella feels so happy to share her sweet treats.

pages.image_prompt: Bella the white rabbit wearing a large red and pink bow between her ears, standing in a sunny carrot patch with a basket of orange carrots, soft children's-book watercolour style, no text in the image
pages.narration_text: Bella wears a large pink bow. She finds sweet carrots. What should Bella do with her yummy basket?

pages.scenario: Bella has bright magenta outlines on her soft fur. She sees a hungry little hedgehog.
pages.question: What should Bella do to help her new friend?

choices.text: Eat the carrot quickly all by herself.
choices.feedback: Bella wants to share her treats to make everyone smile.

choices.text: Give the hedgehog a crunchy carrot with a smile.
choices.feedback: Sharing makes Bella and the little hedgehog both feel so happy!

pages.narration_text: Bella has bright magenta outlines on her soft fur. She sees a hungry little hedgehog. What should Bella do to help her new friend?

pages.scenario: Bella sees two little bluebirds under the big oak tree. Bella holds a crunchy orange carrot with a green top.
pages.question: What should Bella do to make the birds happy?

choices.text: Snap the carrot in two to share with them.
choices.feedback: Bella shares her snack and everyone feels so happy!

choices.text: Rest all alone and ignore the hungry birds.
choices.feedback: Bella wants to help her new bird friends smile instead.

pages.image_prompt: Bella the white bunny holding an orange carrot with a green top, sitting in the soft shade of a grand oak tree next to two happy bluebirds, soft children's-book watercolour style, no text in the image
pages.narration_text: Bella sees two little bluebirds under the big oak tree. Bella holds a crunchy orange carrot with a green top. What should Bella do to make the birds happy?

pages.scenario: Bella wiggles her small round tail by the brook. A tired frog sits sadly on the bank.
pages.question: How can Bella help the little frog feel better?

choices.text: Share her soft carrot greens with him.
choices.feedback: Bella and the happy frog smile together on the soft leafy bed.

choices.text: Keep all the soft greens just for herself.
choices.feedback: Sharing what Bella has will make both of them feel glad.

pages.narration_text: Bella wiggles her small round tail by the brook. A tired frog sits sadly on the bank. How can Bella help the little frog feel better?

pages.scenario: Bella wears a large red and pink bow on Sunflower Hilltop. A tiny field mouse has an empty picnic table.
pages.question: What should Bella do with her prize carrot to help?

choices.text: Place the orange carrot on the little table to share.
choices.feedback: Bella and the mouse both smile brightly as they share lunch.

choices.text: Keep the carrot tucked away for her own dinner later.
choices.feedback: Bella can share with the hungry mouse to make them both happy.

pages.scenario: Bella wiggles her brown whiskers in the soft clover glade. She has one last crunchy carrot left in her basket.
pages.question: What should Bella do when a hungry squirrel visits her?

choices.text: Split the carrot to share with the squirrel
choices.feedback: Bella and the squirrel smile happily as they munch together.

choices.text: Eat the whole carrot quickly by herself
choices.feedback: Bella can share her snack to make a new friend happy.

pages.narration_text: Bella wiggles her brown whiskers in the soft clover glade. She has one last crunchy carrot left in her basket. What should Bella do when a hungry squirrel visits her?

pages.scenario: Bella rests inside the Cozy Hollow Log with her empty basket. Her happy curved black eyes look at the quiet room.
pages.question: How can Bella feel happy inside her cozy home?

choices.text: Wish she kept all the treats for herself.
choices.feedback: Sharing makes Bella and her friends much happier together.

choices.text: Think of her friends smiling because she shared.
choices.feedback: Bella feels so warm and happy remembering their joyful smiles.

pages.scenario: Friends bring sweet berries to Bella. Bella wiggles her small round tail with joy.
pages.question: What should Bella do with all the yummy treats?

choices.text: Take the biggest pile of berries just for herself.
choices.feedback: Eating together will make Bella and her friends much happier.

choices.text: Invite everyone to sit in a circle and eat together.
choices.feedback: Bella and her friends smile big as they share the feast.
